attempted_claim: For every fixed real t, with D₈(X)={d≤X: d is positive, odd, and square-free} and χ₈d the primitive quadratic character of conductor 8d, determine an explicit function c(t)>0, uniformly positive on compact t-intervals, such that liminf_{X→∞} #{d∈D₈(X): L(1/2+2πit/log(8d), χ₈d)≠0}/#D₈(X) ≥ c(t), unconditionally, by evaluating suitable mollified first and second moments.
decisive_failure: No complete TARGET proof and no EMERGENT_FINDING are claimed. The work consists of prior-art triage (Soundararajan 2000 full-text evidence plus one consolidated literature search) and a concrete blocker diagnosis showing the fixed-shift remark does not cover the microscopic d-dependent shift; the shifted uniform mollified-moment analysis remains unproved.
